a hero may yet be fulfilled.

us: That was a most accomplished performance.

jp:
感謝のしるしとして
力いっぱい　ハグをさせてくれ！
us:
For this great boon,
allow me to embrace you each in turn!

jp: あんたのために戦ったわけじゃない
us: Yeah...we're good with just the keystone.

jp: キーストーン　いただきます
us: And we'll take it now, thank you.

jp: もちろんだとも
us: As you wish.

jp:
いまこそ　正統な持ち主へと返そう
さあ　受け取りたまえ
us: I will not deny you what is yours by right. Behold─your prize.

jp: タークス？
us: Seriously!?

jp: てめえ　返しやがれ！
us: You give that back right now!

jp: こんにゃろ！
us: No ya don't!

jp: 先輩　パス！
us: Rude! Catch!

jp: タークスが　どろぼう？
us: Shame on you.

jp: これは　うちの資産だ
us: It's Shinra property.

jp: 黙れ　泥棒！
us: Cut the bullshit.

jp: ルードさん！
us: Rude!

jp: どうなってんだよ
us: What the hell's goin' on?

jp: 逃げちゃったよ？
us: He just took off!

jp: くそっ！　ユフィ　ナナキ　追うぞ
us: Alright! Yuffie, Nanaki─with me.

jp: おまえらは　そっちをなんとかしろ
us: The rest of ya, deal with them!

jp: おい　行こうぜ！
us: Let's get a move on.

jp: リベンジマッチだぞ　と
us: It's time to get some payback for the mines.

jp:
よろしい！
このバトル　我々が仕切らせてもらう
us:
A grudge match then─over which,
I must insist you allow me to officiate.

jp:
しばしのブレイクタイムをはさみ
双方の準備が整い次第　再開とする
us: To ensure a fair and entertaining bout, we'll give you a chance to rest before the festivities.

jp: 用意ができたら　私に声をかけたまえ
us: Once you're ready, you need but say the word.

jp: はやくしてくれない？
us: You think you could hurry it up?

jp: こっちは準備万端なんだけど
us: Just let me kick your ass already.

jp: 怖気づいたか？
us: You should've run.

jp: 片を付けよう
us: We'll make it quick.

jp: 準備は整ったかな？
us: Are you ready to duke it out?

jp: ブラボー　それでは始めようか！
us: Fantastic! Then without further ado...

jp:
盛り上げるなら　オレたち
ソッチとコッチにま・か・せ・な！
us: Nobody brings the hype like us! Scotch and Kotch! Make. Some. Noise, y'all!

jp: どいつもこいつも　見とけ　このバトル！
us: Ladies and gentlemen, keep your eyes on the arena!

jp: 準備はいいか　お・ま・え・ら！
us: 'Cause ready or not... It's time to rumble!

jp: ボーナスラウンド
us: One more round!

jp: かませ～！
us: Let's get it on!

jp: ずるい！
us: No fair!

jp: させない！
us: Back off!

jp: よくやった
us: Well done.

jp: まだまだです！
us: That was nothing.

jp: お～っと　これは勝負あったか？
us:
It looks like the Turks are on the back foot!
Can they pull it together in time?

jp: 笑わせないで　ねっ先輩！
us: We're just getting warmed up. Right, Rude?

jp: ああ　勝負はこれからだ
us: Yeah. This fight's far from over.

jp:
ハローエブリワン！
皆様　コロシアム中央にご注目ください
us: Esteemed spectators! If you would be so kind as to direct your attention to the center of the ring.

jp:
クライマックスをより熱くするため
サプライズゲストをお呼びいたしました
us:
To ensure a fitting climax for this spectacle,
we've invited a special guest.

jp: さあ　盛大な拍手でお迎えください
us: Now, let's give a round of applause for...

jp:
神羅カンパニー新社長
ルーファウス神羅の登場です！
us:
the Shinra Electric Power Company's
very own president: Rufus Shinra!

jp:
なななななな　なんと～
トンでもない事態になりましたー
us: Ohoho! Who could've foreseen this insane turn of events!? I sure as hell couldn't!

jp: 神羅の社長が　乱入してきましたー！
us:
Shinra's president himself has taken the stage,
and the crowd is electric!

jp: 社長　なにやってんですか
us: Mr. President, what are you doing here?

jp: 手続き上　おまえはまだ神羅の一員だ
us: You're still a Shinra employee─at least on paper.

jp: 私が直接　クビにしてやろうと思ってな
us:
And as your boss,
I figured I'd dispose of you personally.

jp: だからって……
us: Was that meant to be a joke?

jp: おまえたちは　ツォンと合流しろ
us: You two go. Wait with Tseng.

jp: 俺をなめているのか？
us: Got my number this time?

jp: 懲戒の時間だ
us: Let's see, shall we?

jp:
いったい　これから
どうなってしまうのでしょうか～！
us:
I've heard of aggressive managers,
but this boss is cutthroat!

jp: 歴史的な試合となりました
us: It's corporate downsizing with a vengeance!

jp:
皆様　ルーファウス社長の雄姿を
しっかりと　目に焼きつけてください！
us: If you wanna savor the action, don't even think about leaving your seat! In fact, don't even blink!

jp: いい気になるなよ
us: Cocky as ever.

jp: 社長の愛犬　ダークネイションの登場だー！
us:
Either my stomach's growlin',
or the president's pooch has joined the fray!

jp: よくしつけられているだろ
us: Well trained, don't you think?

jp: 尻尾を振られて　満足か？
us: Ya can't bite the hand that feeds.

jp: おまえも　しつけが必要だな
us: And yet here you are.

jp: 俺は元ソルジャーだ　当然の結果だな
us:
Not bad, Mr. President.
But you'll never be a SOLDIER.

jp: 余興は終わりだ
us: Enough of this farce.

jp: 逃げられたね
us: So, are we gonna go after him?

jp: 放っておこう　それよりも
us: Not yet. First─

jp: ケット・シー　だよね
us: We find Cait Sith, right?

jp: 捕まえるぞ
us: Right.

jp: お～っと　これはまさかの展開だー！
us:
I thought I'd seen it all, but this is
the mother of all twists! Wha-hoa!

jp:
なんと　両者試合放棄
リングアウトで　試合終了となりました！
us: Ladies and gentlemen, both teams are disqualified! I don't think anyone could've predicted this outcome! What a crazy finish!

jp: みんな　どこに行ったんだろ
us: Should we look for the others too?

jp: ケット・シー　探そう！
us: After Cait, okay?

jp: 外はみんなにまかせて　このへん探そ
us: The others have the outside covered. Let's search in here.

jp: ケット・シー　探そう？
us: We should look for Cait Sith.

jp: キーストーンを取り戻さないと
us: We still need to get the keystone back.

jp: このあたりにいるはずだよ
us: He can't have gotten far.

jp: あそこ！
us: Over there!

jp: にゃーん？
us: Meow...

jp: シシシ！
us: Teehehe...

jp: ゴロゴロゴロ
us: Prr...

jp: うにゃっ！
us: Ah!

jp: ふにゃー！
us: Meow!

jp: ニャー！
us: Fwoo!

jp: ごめんやで～！
us: I hate to do this!

jp: 急いで　追いかけよ！
us: We can't let him get away!

jp: どこかに隠れてるはず
us: We need to find him.

jp: どこだろ？　意外と見えるとこにいたりして
us: He could be anywhere... Maybe even hiding in plain sight!

jp: にゃにゃ！
カンニンしてや～！
us: Och, leave me alone!

jp: 見て！
us: There!

jp: 追いかけよう！
us: After him!

jp:
クラウド
ケット・シー　どっか行っちゃったよ？
us: Hey, Cloud. I searched high and low, but no Cait.

jp: ドロボー猫め～　どこ行きやがった～
us: When I get my hands on that thieving cat, he's in for it!

jp:
おう　無事だったか
ケット・シーの野郎　まだ見つからねえんだ
us: Good to see you're still in one piece. Wish I could tell you I found that damned cat, but...

jp: ここは　オレにまかせろ
us: I'm gonna keep searchin' here.

jp:
クラウド　ごめん
ケット・シー　見失っちゃった
us: Oh... Hey, Cloud. Sorry, I don't have any idea where Cait is.

jp: このあたりには　いないみたいだけど
us: I searched the area, but no luck.

jp:
よう　あのネコ探してんだろ？
こっちには来てないぜ
us: Hey. Lookin' for the robocat? Well, he ain't come through.

jp: さっきの試合　面白かったぜ！
us: Gotta give it to ya, that was some damn good fightin'.

jp: ケット・シーはいない
us: No sign of the cat.

jp: 見つけたら　捕まえておこう
us: I'll keep an eye out.

jp: ツォンさん
us: Got it.

jp: ご無事で
us: Be safe.

jp: あなたこそ
us: You too.

jp: てめえ　どういうつもりだ！
us: Care to explain, cat?

jp: カンニンやで
us: It's...not how it looks?

jp: 神羅にも真っ当なヤツがいる
us: What was I thinkin', trustin' you?

jp:
おまえと会って　そう思えたのによ
やってくれるぜ
us: The company man with a heart of gold. What a joke.

jp: バレット　やめて！
us: Barret, no! Please!

jp: たしかに　弾がもったいねえ
us: Screw it. Piece of shit ain't worth the bullets anyway.

jp: オイラたちを裏切ったの？
us: I don't understand... Why?

jp:
サイッテー！
神羅なんて　信じるんじゃなかった
us: 'Cause he's an asshole! One we should've never trusted in the first place!

jp: 裏切り者とは　いっしょにいられない
us: Don't. He deserves it.

jp: クラウドさん……
us: Not you too...

jp: こうなるってことは　わかってたんやけどなあ
us:
Knew from the start it had to end this way...
but it still stings.

jp: ちょっと　仲良くなりすぎましたわ
us: For a moment there...it felt like we were friends.

jp: ケット・シー　腹立つな～
us: I am so pissed at Cait right now...

jp: きっと　さっそく昇進してるぜ
us: Prob'ly laughin' at us from his new office.

jp:
アタシたちを　ず～っと
だましてたってことでしょ？
us:
How are you not mad!?
He played us for fools from the start!

jp: 思い出したら　またムカムカしてきた～！
us:
Just thinkin' about it makes me
wanna beat the crap outta him!

jp: エアリス　なにか気になる？
us: Hey... Are you okay?

jp: 人を見る目　すこしだけ自信あったんだ
us:
I'll be fine.
Just thought I was a better judge of character.

jp: もう忘れよう
us: Forget him.

jp:
どうすんの？
神羅も　黒マテリアを狙ってるってことでしょ
us: So what's the plan then? We are not just gonna let 'em take the black materia, right!?

jp: 急いで　追いかけないと！
us: We're gonna go after 'em, right?

jp: 追いかけるたって　どうすんだよ？
us: And how we supposed to do that without any leads?

jp:
神殿の場所を知ってるのは
ケット・シーだよね
us: He's got a point. The only one who knows where the temple is is...Cait Sith.

jp:
神殿は知らないが
タークスのヘリなら追跡可能だ
us:
But he told the Turks...
whose chopper I should be able to track.

jp: ほんと？
us: Really!?

jp:
専用の周波数を知っている
連中が無線を使えば　居場所がわかる
us:
I know which radio frequencies they use.
The moment they get on comms, I'll find them.

jp: 無線機なら　タイニーブロンコについてるぜ
us: Well now, the old gal's got a transmitter.

jp: やったな！
us: Then we're in business!

jp: よーし　オレは先行って準備しとくな
us: Alright! I'll run on ahead and get 'er warmed up for ya. Later.

jp:
なんとかなりそうだ
俺たちも　神殿に向かおう
us: It's settled, then. We follow Shinra to the temple.

jp: 黒マテリアは……
us: And the black materia...

jp: 俺たちがもらう
us: will be ours.

jp: よお　クラウド
us: Hey. Remember me?

jp: あんたは……コルネオの
us: You're that guy from Corneo's...

jp: レズリーだ
us: Leslie.

jp:
ここでなにしてるの？
それに　そのケガ
us: What are you doing out here? You look like you've been through hell.

jp:
別れた女を探しまわって
その結果　ここに辿り着いたんだ
us: Got wind my girl might be out this way. Had to follow up─see if there was truth to it.

jp: 彼女の名前は　マールっていうんだ
us: In case I didn't tell ya, her name's Merle.

jp:
ウォール・マーケットであんたらと別れたあと
俺はまず　マールの知り合いを当たってみたんだ
us: After you guys left Wall Market, I started asking around. Hoped one of her friends might know somethin'.

jp:
ただ　当然
コルネオから逃げた女の情報を
us: Shouldna bothered. Even if they did have info, they're not dumb.

jp:
コルネオの手下だった男に
教えてくれるワケもなくてね
us: They wouldn't dare blab to a former Corneo crony.

jp:
なんとか　ミッドガルの外に出たって
情報だけを手に入れて
us: But I was able to find out she wasn't in Midgar anymore.

jp:
それからは　街を転々としながら
地道な聞き込みさ
us: And ever since then, I've been movin' from town to town─lookin' for leads.

jp:
ウォール・マーケットは　アニヤンたちが
七番街の避難所として開放した結果
us: Well, you saw. After the plate fell, the trio opened the place to refugees.

jp:
ずいぶんと人が増えて
さらに騒がしい街になってるよ
us:
Town tripled in size.
Man, if you thought it was lively before...

jp:
ただ　コルネオの力を失って
神羅とのパイプもなくなったからな
us:
Unfortunately...when Corneo pulled up stakes,
he took all that Shinra money with him.

jp:
正直なところ
いつ潰されてもおかしくない状態だ
us:
I'm not gonna sugarcoat it...
Wall Market's days are numbered.

jp:
マムが動いてくれているらしいが
どうなるかな
us: Madam M's tryin' to work her magic, but...I dunno.

jp: 七番街は……まだまだ先が見えない状態だ
us: Sector 7's still a mess... Prob'ly gonna stay that way for a while.

jp:
竜巻被害で　ハイウェイが崩壊したのは
知ってるよな？
us: Expressway collapsed right after the plate...

jp: それに加えて　突然の社長交代だろ
us:
then outta the blue, company decides it
needs a new president.

jp:
神羅は七番街どころじゃないのさ
特にスラムへの対応は　すべて後まわしになってる
us: Seems pretty clear Shinra doesn't give a shit about Sector 7. Undercity especially, but that shouldn't come as a surprise.

jp:
いまは　住民たちがガレキの撤去作業と
行方不明者の把握を進めているみたいだ
us: The people've stepped up though: clearing the rubble, helping the injured, locating the missing.

jp: それで……実は
us: So the thing is...

jp:
ここを仕切っているロンリー・ゲスのパーティーで
ある女が　景品にされている
us: Gus is running a special competition─and a woman is the prize.

jp:
ミッドガルから逃げてきた　訳アリの女らしい
それが　俺の尋ね人じゃないかと思ってな
us: Word around the Dustbowl is she fled here from Midgar. It's just a hunch, but I think she might be who I'm looking for.

jp: 景品？　信じられない
us: She's a prize? That's sick.

jp: ロンリー・ゲスは　紳士とは言えない
us: Gus is a real piece of shit, to put it mildly.

jp: そのケガは？
us: He do that?

jp: パーティーでやられた
us: Monsters did.

jp:
パーティーなんて呼んでるけど
ゲス流の　ねじくれた冗談だ
us:
Gus is calling it a "party," but...
it's an excuse to see blood.

jp:
実際は　モンスターと遊ぶことになる
命懸けでな
us:
Lots of it. He pits people against fiends...
and his money's on the latter.

jp: そこで　あんたに仕事を頼みたい
us: I lost...so this is where you guys come in.

jp: パーティーに参加して　景品を勝ち取ってくれ
us: Join the "party," win, and free that woman.

jp: いまでも　なんでも屋なんだろ？
us: Still a merc, aren'tcha? No reason not to.

jp: まあな
us: True...

jp: 頼む
us: Please.

jp: パーティーは　５人１チームで参加できる
us: So you know, need a team of five to sign up.

jp: モンスターと５戦　タイマンバトルだ
us: In the ring, though? It's one-on-one.

jp: 挑戦できるのは　人間だけだ
us: And humans only, I'm afraid.

jp:
あんたらなら　きっとやれる
コルネオ杯で優勝した力　見せつけてやってくれ
us: I'm counting on you, and so's the woman. If anyone can put Gus in his place, it's Wall Market's reigning champs.

jp:
あれから　ずっと彼女を探し続けてきた
ようやくつかんだ手掛かりなんだ
us: This is the first real lead I've had since I left Midgar. Just hope it isn't a dead-end.

jp:
ここで育成したモンスターを高値で売ってるんだ
コルネオも　よく取引してたよ
us: The fiends they raise here command a high price. I should know─Corneo was a...frequent customer.

jp:
ここの連中は　ウォール・マーケットよりも
イカれてやがる
us: These people...they make Wall Market's worst look like angels.

jp: あんたでも厳しいか　参ったな
us: And I thought the Corneo Cup was tough... Damn.

jp: 依頼は継続だ　引き続き頼む
us: You gotta keep tryin' for me. For her.

jp: パーティーに参加したいのか？
us: You here to "join the party"?

jp: ビーストバトルグラウンドへ　ようこそ
us: Welcome to the famed Beast Battleground!

jp: モンスターと遊んでいくかい？
us: You lookin' to play with some monsters?

jp: 血に飢えたら　また来な
us: We're here if ya get a hankerin' for blood.

jp: いつでも歓迎するぜ
us: Challengers are always welcome.

jp: なんだ　怖気づいたか？
us: You chicken? Is that your deal?

jp:
フォウ！
ようこそ　オレ様のパーティーへ
us: Woo! Y'all ready for the party of your lives!?

jp: 本日のチャレンジャーは～？
us: Today's challengers are...

jp:
チョコボレースで優勝をかっさらった
クラウド・ナントカと　取り巻きだ～！
us: the champion of chocobos─the racing ace himself, Cloud the Knife and crew!

jp: アタシが相手だよ！
us: Bring it on, jerks!

jp:
対するは　オレ様がそろえた
スーパーなモンスターたちだ～！
us: Versus! My personal pick of the fiercest, most ferocious fiends you have ever seen!

jp:
さあおまえら　盛りあがる準備は済んだか？
ゲスでド派手な　パーティーの始まりだーーー！
us: This is it, folks! You're about to witness a brutal bloodbath of untold proportions! Let the shit hit the fan!

jp:
フォウ！　こいつは驚きだぜ
クラウド・ナントカ
us: Who could've expected an upset like this!?

jp: まさかここまで来るとは　いいチームじゃねえか
us: Cloud the Knife's team has made it to the finals!

jp:
しかし　遊びはここまで
こっからが本番だ！
us:
But! Playtime's over!
This here's the real moment of truth!

jp:
そんじゃあ　おまえら
叫ぶ準備はいいか！
us: Are you ready? I wanna hear some noise, people!

jp: 我らが最高傑作　ジョーカーのおでましだ！
us: Give it up for everyone's nightmare, the murder machine supreme!

jp: 数多の挑戦者をもてあそび続けて　いまだ無敗
us: No challengers have ever managed to beat this fearsome fiend!

jp:
クラウド・ナントカは
この血塗られた道化に打ち勝ち
us: Does our merc and his crew have what it takes to be the first?

jp:
景品のカワイコちゃんを
手に入れることができるのか
us: Will they be able to claim our darling little grand prize!?

jp:
さあ　声あげてけよ～
クライマックスの始まりだーーー！
us: You're about to find out, folks! This is the moment we've been waiting for! A desert bloodbath!

jp: ハデにやられたな
us: Least ya lost with style.

jp: これに懲りずに　また来てくれよ
us: Gonna call it a day, or give it another try?

jp: 死ななかっただけ　ラッキーだぜ
us: You're damn lucky ya didn't get put down.

jp: やるじゃねえか
us: Not bad!

jp: さすが　噂のクラウド・ナントカだな
us: I'd expect nothin' less from "Cloud the Knife."

jp: あんたこそ　本物のモンスターだぜ
us: Heh, you're the real monster.

jp:
フォウ！　クラウドの熱いダンス
堪能させてもらったぜ
us: Woo! Cloud, my man! Way to give the people a show!

jp:
しかし　まさか
オレ様の秘蔵っ子をやっちまうとはな
us: Gotta say, never thought my little baby'd get so thoroughly crushed.

jp: チキショウ！
us: Dammit!

jp:
最悪だぜマジで！
いくらかかったと思ってんだ　クソがーーー！
us: Do you have any idea how much gil I spent on that thing, you inconsiderate son of a bitch!?

jp:
ふん　まあいい
過ぎたことだ
us: Eh. It's done. S'all good.

jp: 先を見ようぜ　オレ様とおまえの未来をよ
us: Gotta look to the future─our future.

jp:
どうだ　クラウド
オレ様の専属にならねえか？
us: Whaddya say? We'd make one helluva team.

jp:
チョコボレースに　バトルグラウンド
稼ぎまくれるぜ～？
us:
Could clean up at the fights and the races.
Come on, ya know you wanna.

jp: 断る
us: No.

jp:
ハハ　つれねえなあ！
いまなら特別待遇で迎えてやるぞ　どうだ？
us: Hah! Don't do me like that. I'll throw in some perks on top. That should sweeten the deal, right?

jp: 女はどこだ？
us: Where's the girl?

jp:
おっ　なんだカワイコちゃんが目当てか？
おまえもスミにおけねえなあ
us:
Oh, so you really were after our little prize.
You sir are a dirty dog.

jp: よし　特別に女をオマケしてやるぜ
us: Well, you're welcome to her! You earned it!

jp:
な～に　なんでも屋とオレ様の仲だ
遠慮すんな
us:
Just as a wittle show of good faith.
Go on, don't be shy.

jp:
だから　専属になる件
考え直してみねえか
us: And then maybe think over that deal? Pretty please?

jp: ねえ
us: Hey.

jp: おっ　ここにもカワイコちゃん
us: Hello. Where did you come from, beautiful?

jp: 姉ちゃんも　オレ様の専属になるかい？
us: You lookin' to get in good with the Gus Man?

jp: 二度と人を景品にしないで
us: Don't ever pull this crap again.

jp:
もしまた景品に人がまじってたら
手加減しない　いい？
us: You offer any more people as prizes, they'll have to scrape you off my shoe. Got it?

jp: は……は……はい～
us: Hrn... Yes, ma'am...

jp: 恋人さんと再会できた？
us: So, how did the reunion go?

jp: 別人だった
us: Different girl.

jp: えっ？
us: What?

jp: ミッドガルからの観光客だったらしい
us: Was just a random tourist from Midgar.

jp:
ゴールドソーサーで詐欺にあって
売られたって話だ
us:
Fell for a scam at the Saucer
and ended up down here.

jp: 上に送り届けて　保護してもらったよ
us: I sent her back up─made sure she's safe.

jp: そっか……
us: Oh... I'm sorry.

jp: 再会は　おあずけだ
us: Don't be. I'll find her eventually.

jp: あきらめないからな
us: I'm sure of it.

jp:
それで　あんたらは
これからどうするんだ
us: Anyway... What's next for you and the others?

jp: 旅の途中だ　手に入れたい物がある
us:
We're looking for something too.
Need to find it ASAP.

jp: 俺たち　いつもなにか探してるな
us: Funny... Always the same story with us.

jp: 幸運を祈るよ
us: Good luck to you.

jp: レズリーも
us: And you.

jp: クラウド　待ってたよ！
us: Oh! Hey, Cloud! Got some news.

jp:
実は　これまでの成績が認められて
ゴールドカップに出場できるようになったんだ
us: Apparently, the powers that be like what we have to offer. Gave us permission to race in the Gold Cup!

jp:
すでにエントリーはしてあるからね
もちろん　騎手はクラウドで！
us: So I went and signed you up as soon as I could. After all, you're the best jockey I know!

jp:
ゴールドカップは　３レース連続で行われて
順位ポイントの合計で争うんだ
us: The Cup is three races, and you get points based on where you place in each. Bird with the most at the end wins.

jp:
これまでのレースとは　ひと味もふた味も違うから
しっかり準備しておいたほうがいいよ
us: But the races are like nothin' you've ever seen before. Gotta be on the ball if ya wanna take the top spot.

jp:
それじゃあ　チョコボレースの最高峰に
挑戦する用意ができたら　受付から参加してね
us: Anyway, when you're ready to face off against the finest riders this side of the continent, head on over to registration.

jp: チョコボの調整は完璧だから　安心して
us: Your bird'll be in peak condition─trust me.

jp: ゴールドカップで戦う準備はできた？
us: Ready to ruffle some feathers in the Gold Cup?

jp: クラウド騎手　お待ちしておりました
us: Welcome, sir. We've been waiting for you.

jp: 本日開催中のレースは　こちらになります
us: The following races are scheduled for today.

jp: 本日は　どのレースに出走されますか？
us: Which of these races will you be competing in?

jp: またのお越しを　お待ちしております
us: We eagerly await your return.

jp: クラウド騎手なら　いつでも大歓迎です
us:
Please remember that you
are always welcome here, sir.

jp: また白熱したレースをお願いします
us: We're all looking forward to your next race.

jp: クラウド！
us: Cloud!

jp:
やっと　やっと出られるんだ
夢にまでに見たゴールドカップに！
us: I can't believe it. This is really happening! We're about to race in the Gold Cup!

jp:
ああ　この時を
どれだけ待ち望んできたか……
us: Aw hell, I can't tell you how long I've been waiting for this moment! We made it!

jp: 落ち着いて
us: Rein it in.

jp: 落ち着いてられないよ！
us: Couldn't even if I wanted!

jp:
クラウド　チョコボの調整はバッチリだから
あとは――
us: Okay, Cloud! Your bird's ready and rarin' to go. All that's left is─

jp: 八百長だ？　馬鹿らしい
us: "Cheatin'"? If that ain't the stupidest...

jp:
負けたヤツらが　腹いせに言いふらしてるんだろ
正式に否定コメントを出しとけ
us: Obviously some sore losers're tryin' to raise a stink. We'd best nip this thing in the bud.

jp:
『サムズデリバリーが強いのは
　チョコボ愛のたまものだ』ってな
us: You tell 'em the reason we keep winnin' is 'cause we know how to take care of our birds.

jp:
よお　なんでも屋
それに　ティファちゃん
us: Long time no see, merc. And Miss Tifa too.

jp:
来るなら言ってくれよ
ＶＩＰ席を用意したのに
us: Shoulda told me you were droppin' by─woulda given you the royal treatment.

jp: こんにちは
us: Oh! Hey, Sam.

jp:
エントリー表に名前を見たときは驚いたぜ
まさか　チョコボ乗りになってるとはな
us: Gotta say, I was surprised to see your name on the jockey list. What sparked your interest in bird racin'?

jp: なりゆきだ
us: This and that.

jp:
なりゆきで　うちのエースを負かしやがって
無敗記録が途絶えちまったじゃねえか
us: Fell into it, didja? Well, you're a natural. Not just anybody can break my ace's streak.

jp:
あれは　ただの調整レース
負けに勘定するなんてナンセンスだ
us:
That was just a practice race.
My official record is still pristine.

jp:
今回はゴールドカップ　このレースのために
トウホウフハイを仕上げてきた
us: This is the Gold Cup. The contest for which Hyperion and I have trained nonstop.

jp: 俺たちが後れを取ることは　二度とない
us: You got the drop on us before, but you won't get lucky twice.

jp:
いいねえ
ヒリついたレース　期待してるぜ
us: Now we're talkin'! You two are gonna give the people a race to remember.

jp: おまえは……
us: You're...?

jp: グリン牧場の　グリングリンです
us: Billy. I work on Bill's ranch.

jp:
あなたが殺した
リングリンとチョイスの息子です
us: You might remember my parents─Will and Clara─since you killed 'em.

jp: ほう……？
us: Did I?

jp: あなたは同業の　ぼくの両親が邪魔になった
us: Don't play dumb. You were mad their business was eating into your profits.

jp:
だから　ギャンブル漬けにして消したんだ
そうでしょ！
us: So you got 'em addicted to gamblin'─was all part of your grand plan!

jp: そんな単純な話じゃねえよ
us: ...Wouldn't say the story's that simple.

jp:
でも　ガキにゃあまだ早い
真相は大人になるまでガマンしな
us: But the truth can be one bitter drink...and you ain't nowhere near old enough to keep it down.

jp:
ぼくが　ガキかどうか
レースで決めましょうよ
us: I ain't just some stupid kid, and I'll prove it to you!

jp:
うちのクラウドがゴールドカップで勝ったら
ぜんぶ話してください
us: If my man here wins the Gold Cup, that's proof I'm old enough to hear your "truth"!

jp: いいだろう
us: You're on.

jp:
田舎牧場には無理だと思うが
まあ　せいぜいがんばるんだな
us: Piddly little ranch like yours ain't got a chance, but...best of luck to y'all.

jp: クラウド　責任重大だよ
us: Sure about this? Pressure's on now.

jp: ああ　でも……勝てばいいんだろ？
us: Yeah, well...all I gotta do is win it all, right?

jp:
さあ　歓声があふれんばかりの　ここ
ゴールドソーサーチョコボレース場
us:
Hello and welcome, ladies and gentlemen,
to the Gold Saucer's chocobo racetrack...

jp:
本日は　チョコボレーサーたちの頂点を決める
ゴールドカップです
us: which today plays host to racing's biggest competition: the Gold Cup!

jp:
ゴールドカップは　３レース行われ
順位ポイントの合計で争われます
us: Over three grueling races, our contenders will push themselves to the limit!

jp:
世界中のチョコボファームから選ばれた
選りすぐりのチョコボと騎手たちが
us: The world is watching with bated breath as the best of the best take their places...

jp: いま　スターティングゲートへと入っていきます
us: for what will surely be one heck of a race.

jp:
１番人気はもちろん　サムズデリバリー所属
ジョー＆トウホウフハイ
us:
Fan favorite Joe will be riding the chocobo
Hyperion for Sam's Delivery Service...

jp:
本日も精悍な顔つきで
ゴールの先で輝く　栄光の杯を狙っております
us: and─given his track record─many expect the decorated champion to be first across the finish line.

jp:
さあ各チョコボ　ゲートに入り
大舞台の準備は整いました
us: Alright, folks. Our contenders are ready. Every gate is occupied, so this is it.

jp: まもなく　ゴールドカップのスタートです
us: The moment you've been waiting for: the Gold Cup!

jp: さあ　興奮さめやらぬなか
us: We hope you're ready for more, ladies and gentlemen...

jp:
ゴールドカップ第２レースが
まもなく　始まろうとしています！
us:
because we're just getting started!
Here comes our next race!

jp:
熾烈な戦いを繰り広げてきました
ゴールドカップも次が最終レースです
us: This is turning into one heated tournament, folks! But who will be riding home with the Gold Cup!?

jp:
各チョコボがゲートに入り　第３レースが
いま　スタートしようとしています！
us: Only one more race remains in this exciting event! Let's see who comes out on top!

jp:
悔しいけど　仕方ないね
次こそ　黄金のトロフィーを持ち帰ろう
us: No use beatin' ourselves up, I say. Let's focus on winning the next one instead.

jp:
さすが最高峰のレース　簡単には勝てないね
準備を整えて　また挑戦しよう
us: Certainly didn't expect a race this prestigious to be a cakewalk. But hey, still got time to get back on the bird.

jp:
ゴールドカップで勝つには　もっと強くならないと
腕を磨いたら　再チャレンジしよう
us: Sometimes ya eat the bear, and sometimes the bear eats you. If we're gonna win this thing, we gotta train a helluva lot harder.

jp:
ゴールドカップを制したのは
グリン牧場所属　クラウド騎手です！
us:
Cloud Strife, riding for Bill's Chocobo Ranch,
has won the cup in a stunning upset!

jp: ７番人気から　大番狂わせです！
us: It looks like seven must have been his lucky number!

jp:
グラスランドからの刺客が見事に勝ち切り
黄金の杯に　勝利の美酒を注ぎました！
us: No one saw that snake in the grasslands coming, and now his team is savoring the sweet taste of victory!

jp: なんということでしょう！
us: I cannot believe it!

jp:
黄金の杯を勝ち取ったのは
グリン牧場所属　クラウド騎手！
us: The Gold Cup goes to none other than Cloud Strife and Bill's Chocobo Ranch!

jp: ３戦３勝　前代未聞の完全優勝です！
us:
He's taken three races in a row in an
unprecedented flawless victory!

jp:
グラスランドからやってきた刺客が
チョコボレース界に　新たな歴史を刻みました！
us: No one saw this snake in the grasslands coming, and now the racing world is sure to remember his name!

jp: よくやった
us: Nice work.

jp:
クラウド　やったよ
ゴールドカップ獲れたよ～！
us: You did it, Cloud! You really did it! You went and won us the Gold Cup!

jp: ああ……わかったから　離してくれ
us: Yeah, I know. Mind letting me breathe?

jp: ナイスレース
us: Nice riding.

jp:
やりやがったな　この野郎！
また　おいしいところをかっさらいやがって
us: There's the streak-ruinin' bastard. You stole the title right out from under my nose.

jp: トウホウフハイも悪くなかった
us: Well, Hyperion didn't make it easy.

jp: はは　言うじゃねえか
us: Heh... I'd hope not.

jp: 今回は完敗だ　いいチョコボを育てたな
us:
Mighty fine bird you raised.
He beat mine fair and square.

jp:
約束　覚えてますよね？
父さんと母さんのこと　話してください
us: Just tell me: what happened to my parents? I held up my end of the bargain─now it's your turn.

jp:
おまえ　両親が牧場と並行して始めた
新しい事業のことは知ってるのか？
us: Son...do you know what kinda business yer parents were tryin' to break into after they got their ranch up and runnin'?

jp: 野生のチョコボの保護だ
us: Wild chocobo conservation.

jp:
環境の変化で　野生のチョコボが
年々減ってきているのは　業界でも問題になっていた
us: It's no secret that environmental changes have been hard on the birds─and what's bad for them is bad for business.

jp: ただ　誰も動こうとはしなかった
us: Unfortunately, nobody seemed to care.

jp:
当然さ　環境保護なんざ莫大な費用がかかるくせに
１ギルにもならないときてやがる
us: Savin' the planet ain't cheap, y'see. Folks know somebody's gotta pay for it, but they'll be damned if it's gonna be them.

jp:
だから　誰もが見て見ぬフリだ
そんななか立ちあがったのが　おまえの両親だ
us: So while everybody else turned a blind eye, one couple faced the problem head on: your parents.

jp: ふたりには　情熱があった
us: They had everything they'd need.

jp: 才能も知識も行動力もあった
us: The know-how, drive, and passion.

jp: だが　残念ながら金がなかった
us: Thing is, none of that counts for much if you ain't got the gil.

jp:
資金不足から借金に借金を重ね　そして
ついには　最悪なヤツのところへ転がり込んだ
us: So they went around takin' out loans left and right till they were swimmin' in debt─which is when they ran into the meanest shark of 'em all.

jp: どこだかわかるか？
us: Reckon you know who.

jp: ドン・コルネオ
us: Don Corneo.

jp: あとから知ったことだが
us: I didn't know it at the time...

jp:
コルネオは当時　神羅のために
怪しい実験の参加者を集めていたらしい
us: but that sleazy sonuvabitch was roundin' up folks and shippin' 'em off to Shinra for their "experiments."

jp:
リングリンとチョイスは
事業を守るために　体を差し出したんだ
us: Will and Clara figured it was the only way they'd be able to save their business...so they signed up.

jp:
ある日　リングリンが来て
事業を引き継いでくれと頭を下げた
us: While later, Will paid me a visit. Begged me to "take the reins" in his and Clara's stead.

jp: あいつのチョコボ愛は底なしだ
us: He wanted what was best for those birds.

jp:
俺も　その気になっちまって
事業を買い取ったんだ
us: As did I, so I took him up on the offer and bought 'em out.

jp: 以来　おまえの両親には会っていない
us: And since then, I ain't seen either one of yer parents.

jp:
あとになって　コルネオやら神羅のことを聞いたが
あの連中相手に俺ができることはなにもなかった
us: It was only after that I heard about Corneo's antics through the grapevine. Couldn't do a thing to stop him─not with Shinra in the wings, that's for sure.

jp: ぼくと妹のことは　なにか言ってましたか
us: They say anything about me? Or my sister?

jp: 俺には　なにも
us: Not to me, no.

jp:
捨てられたとか思うなよ
あいつらが守ったのは　おまえたちの未来だ
us: Don't go thinkin' they forgot about you. You and yer sister were always at the forefront of their minds.

jp:
事業には失敗したが　その責任は
自分の未来を捨てることで　きっちりと取った
us: The business might've gone south, but they chose to give up their future to make sure you two could have yers.

jp: だから　牧場と家と食い扶持が残っただろ
us: That's why you got a roof over yer head, a place to work, and food to eat.

jp:
知らなかった……
ぼくは　なにも知らなかった
us: I can't believe it... I've had it wrong this whole time...

jp:
世界中で野生のチョコボが生き残っているのは
間違いなく　おまえの両親の功績だ
us: Son, I'd be surprised if there's a wild chocobo out there that doesn't owe its freedom to your mom and yer dad, one way or another.

jp:
おまえにその気があるなら
チョコボ保護事業は返してやる
us: Hell of a legacy to live up to─but if you want it, the business is yers.

jp: ただし　万年赤字部門だ
us: Just know this: it ain't gonna turn a profit.

jp:
資金計画をしっかり立てないと
なにもかもなくしてしまうぞ
us: So, unless you can find a way to fund it, you'll wind up in the same trouble as your folks.

jp: じいさんと　しっかり相談するんだな
us: Think it over. Maybe chat with Paw-paw too.

jp: 賭けるか？
us: Call it.

jp:
裏か表か　当てられたら
運営資金をサポートしてやるよ
us: Heads or tails, son. Get it right, and I'll float you some operatin' capital.

jp:
結構です　自分でなんとかします
妹と　じいちゃんといっしょに
us: Thanks, but no thanks. I'm gonna do this on my own. Me and Chloe and Gramps, I mean.

jp:
がんこなところは　父親似
気が強いところは　母親似だな
us: You truly are their boy. Got your old man's pig head and your mother's backbone. Not bad.

jp:
ぼく　もっともっと頑張ります
父さんと母さんの想い　大切にしなくちゃ
us: I'm gonna do my parents proud─you'll see. It may take some time, but I'll make sure their legacy lives on.

jp:
でも　どうしてじいちゃんは
サムが悪いみたいな話をしたんだろう
us: I don't get it. If Gramps knew all this, why'd he make it sound like Sam was to blame?

jp:
コルネオや神羅のような　危険な相手に
あなたの憎しみが向かわないように
us: He was probably trying to protect you─to stop you from going after Corneo or Shinra on your own.

jp:
それにサムなら　ぜんぶ受け止めてくれるって
そう考えたんじゃないかな
us: So he pinned it on Sam─knowing that your uncle would be okay shouldering the blame.

jp: 親の仇討ちとか　バカなことは考えるなよ
us: Shouldn't have to tell you this, but seeking revenge would be stupid.

jp: うん……
us: I know.

jp:
でも　もしチャンスが来たら
クラウド　手伝ってくれるよね
us: Still, if an opportunity did happen to come along, you'd help me out, wouldn't you?

jp: 俺はいまや　ゴールドカップ優勝騎手だ
us: Hey, I'm a world-famous jockey now.

jp: 下品な連中には近づきたくない
us: Can't be associated with that kind of stuff.

jp: 本当だね！
us: You had me goin' there!

jp:
サムから事業を引き取れるようになるためにも
もっと　レースで勝たないと
us: If I'm gonna get the money to buy back my parent's ranch, I'll need to rack up more wins.

jp: 野生のチョコボについて　あらためて勉強するよ
us: I'm fixin' to brush up on my knowledge of wild chocobos.

jp:
見たよ　コルネオたちとのバトル！
ありがとう　すこしだけ心が晴れたよ
us: I saw your battle with that bastard Corneo! Felt real good seein' you tan his hide like that.

jp: コルネオめ　砂漠で干からびればいいんだ
us: Man like that deserves a slow death in the desert.

jp:
父さんと母さんが残してくれた資料を
あらためて読んでるけど　すごい情報量だよ
us: I've been going over the documents Mom and Dad left behind. It's a lot to wrap my head around.

jp:
今度　サムズデリバリーの環境部門で
勉強できることになったんだ
us: Seems Sam's people've got plenty to teach me about environmental conservation work.

jp: チョコボレースの調子はどう？
us: How're the races treatin' ya?

jp: なんだ　なんか始まったぞ？
us: Huh? Somethin' going on?

jp:
さすがは究極の遊び人
踊りもうまいね
us: It's no surprise the Ultimate Party Animal is also a Dancing King.

jp:
あのスーツの男
噂のゲームマスターだろ？
us: Isn't that guy the game whiz everyone's been talking about?

jp: あれって　遊び人の神羅課長だろ
us: Hey! That's the Ultimate Party Animal!

jp: 遊び人の弟子にしてもらえないかな
us: I wonder if he'd be willing to take me under his wing!

jp: なになに　なんのイベント？
us: Whoa! What's the occasion?

jp: わかんない　突然踊りだしたの
us: No idea. He just started dancing.

jp:
あのスーツの人って
ゴールドソーサーを制覇した人でしょ
us: That guy is the same one who conquered all the Saucer's attractions, right?

jp:
あの人　神羅課長だよね
ゲームの達人の！
us: He's just a middle manager or something, so how'd he get so good at games?

jp: ねえ　究極の遊び人ってどのひと？
us: Wait─which one's the party animal?

jp:
おお　君たち！
奇遇ですね　観光ですか～？
us: What a coincidence meeting you here! Taking some time off to "max and relax"?

jp: あんたは　神羅の……
us: You're that Shinra paper pusher.

jp: イエーイ！
us: You know it!

jp: ここで　踊ってるのか
us: So...you're into dancing?

jp: はい　そのとおり！
us: There's nothing more freeing!

jp:
長年会社に身を捧げていた　いち会社員が
ホンモノの遊びに目覚めたってところです
us: After years of slaving away for the company, this white-collar worker has finally learned how to let loose and have fun!

jp: コスタの始末書を提出したあと
us: After I put in for a leave of absence...

jp:
なにもかもが嫌になったあたしは
休暇を取って　この楽園へ辿り着いたんです～！
us: I bid farewell to Costa del Sol and made my way to this golden paradise of delights!

jp: これまでの鬱憤を晴らすべく　遊び回っていたら
us: I've been trying out all the attractions to help clear my mind...

jp:
ゴールドソーサー中のアトラクションで
最高スコアを　叩きだしてしまいましてね
us: and before I knew it, I'd somehow racked up more high scores than I could count! Can you believe it?

jp:
いまでは『究極の遊び人』なんて呼ばれてます
いやはや　お恥ずかしい
us: Now everyone's calling me the "Ultimate Party Animal." That's certainly not a title I ever imagined earning.

jp: ああ　そうそう
us: Speaking of!

jp:
ちょうど『究極の遊び人からの挑戦状』という
イベントが始まるんですよ
us: There's a campaign called the "Ultimate Party Animal Challenge" that's scheduled to start quite soon!

jp:
あたしが　各アトラクションで記録したスコアに
みなさんで挑んでもらうんです
us: The goal is to try and beat the high scores yours truly set on all the attractions.

jp: このダンスは　イベントの宣伝も兼ねてましてね
us: Part of the reason we're dancing here now is to advertise the event.

jp: よかったら　参加してみてください
us: You're more than welcome to get in on the fun.

jp: それでは　挑戦お待ちしてますよ～！
us: I've got high hopes for you! So don't let me down!

jp: なんか　イベントが始まるんだって？
us: Sounds like they're holding an event!

jp: 究極の遊び人から　挑戦状だってよ
us: It's the Ultimate Party Animal Challenge!

jp: 俺　Ｇバイクならイケると思うんだよな
us: I might stand a chance in that G-Bike game, at least.

jp:
挑戦状か　俺も
究極の遊び人を目指してみるかな
us: So it's a competition? Maybe I should see if I've got what it takes to claim his title.

jp:
弟子にしてくださいって
勇気を出して言えばよかった
us: Wish I could've worked up the courage to ask to be his apprentice before he left.

jp:
あれ　神羅課長は？
帰っちゃった？
us: Wait, where'd that guy go? He leave?

jp:
実は　クイーンズ・ブラッドだけは
自信あるんだよね
us: I bet I could take him in Queen's Blood at least. I'm actually pretty good.

jp:
あ～　行っちゃった
サイン欲しかったのに
us: Aw man, he left! I was hoping to get his autograph.

jp: 遊び人のスコアに勝てるわけないじゃん
us: There's no way I could ever beat his high scores.

jp: あたしも　挑戦してみようかな
us: I think I'm gonna go for it!

jp: お待ちしておりました！
us: I knew you'd answer the call!

jp:
さて　究極の遊び人が叩きだしたスコアを
打ち破ることができるか　レッツ・トラ～イ！
us: Without further ado, let's see if you can top the high scores set by the living legend─me! The Ultimate Party Animal!

jp: おっ　挑戦されますか～？
us: Oho. Ready to take me on?

jp: 中間管理職の本気ってヤツを　見せてあげますよ
us: I'll teach you not to underestimate the hidden talents of a middle manager!

jp: 来ましたね～！
us: There he is!

jp:
では早速　あたしが企画したバトルコースに
挑戦してもらいましょうか
us: But does he have what it takes to overcome the series of battles designed by the Ultimate Party Animal!?

jp: ふふふ　待ってましたよ
us: Heh... Been waiting for you.

jp:
それでは　このあたしと
チョコボレースで対決です！
us: And now...the ultimate chocobo racing showdown!

jp: ようこそ　みなさん
us: Welcome one and all!

jp:
それでは　あたしが叩きだした前人未踏の記録に
挑戦してもらいましょうか！
us: Is anyone here bold enough to try and beat my unprecedented high score? Challengers─step forward!

jp:
さあ　続いては
クイーンズ・ブラッドで勝負です
us: I'll gladly treat anyone to a friendly game of Queen's Blood.

jp: あたしの最強カードデッキを　とくとご覧あれ！
us: Though I doubt you'll stand a chance against my ultimate deck!

jp: 第１関門クリア　おめでとう！
us: Congratulations on clearing the first challenge!

jp:
これで君も　遊び人としての一歩目を
踏み出したわけです
us: You've taken your first step toward becoming a true party animal.

jp:
その調子で　ゴールドソーサーを遊び尽くし
『究極の遊び人』を目指してください！
us: Keep making the most of your time here at the Gold Saucer, until you too reach my lofty heights!

jp: 第２関門クリア　おめでとう！
us: Congrats on clearing the second challenge!

jp: これで　ようやく君も『普通の遊び人』です
us: You've now earned the title of "Typical Party Animal."

jp:
まだまだ　どこにでもいる遊び人だから
おごらないことですよ
us: It's just a start, but I'm sure you'll continue to rise through the ranks.

jp: 引き続き　頑張ってください
us: So don't lose that party spirit!

jp: 第３関門クリア　おめでとう！
us: Congrats on clearing the third challenge!

jp: いまや君は　『注目の遊び人』です
us: I hereby proclaim you a "Renowned Party Animal."

jp:
まわりの目が変わってきたことに
気がつきませんか？
us: The people are starting to stand up and take notice.

jp:
しかし　まだまだ上があります
向上心を忘れずに　挑み続けてください
us: But! You still have a long way to go. Don't you dare slow down now─the party must go full speed ahead!

jp: 第４関門クリア　おめでとう！
us: Congrats on clearing the fourth challenge!

jp: 君はもう『羨望の遊び人』です
us: I hereby proclaim you an "Enviable Party Animal."

jp: 君の遊びっぷりに　みんなが魅了されています
us: Everyone's absolutely mesmerized by your merry-making moves.

jp:
ただ　ここで満足しないことです
更なる高みを目指していきましょう！
us: But! You can't get complacent. You must rise ever higher, until you can party in the heavens!

jp:
第５関門クリア　おめでとう！
ここまで登りつめたのは　君が初めてです
us: Congratulations on clearing the fifth challenge! Be proud─you're the first contestant to have made it this far.

jp: まさに『華麗なる遊び人』　すばらしい！
us:
You alone are a "Magnificent Party Animal"!
Well done!

jp: しかし　まだ遊びを極めたとは言えません
us: However! It is still too early to name you the "ultimate"!

jp:
なぜなら　『究極の遊び人』である
あたしがいるから！
us: And why? Because I hold that title, and there can only be one!

jp:
だから最後に　あたしと
究極の名を賭けて３Ｄバトラーで勝負です！
us: All will be settled in a final match! You and me! In an epic 3D battle! For the honor and the glory and the party!

jp: 面白い　やってやろう
us: Fine by me. You're on.

jp:
それでは　３Ｄバトラーの前で
お待ちしています
us: Very well! Then I shall be waiting for you...fellow party animal.

jp:
ふふ　待ってましたよ
華麗なる遊び人　クラウド
us:
Heh... There you are, Cloud.
The Magnificent Party Animal.

jp:
それでは　どちらがゴールドソーサーで
１番の遊び人か　決めるとしましょうか！
us: If you're ready, then let us settle once and for all who is the best of the best! The Gold Saucer's party god!

jp:
もっとやってくれるかと思ったのに　残念です
修行を積んだら　また挑戦してください
us: I was so sure you'd do better than that, but what a shame. Don't give up, though─practice more and try again.

jp:
これが　究極というものです
再戦なら　いつでもお受けしますよ
us: I'm not called the "Ultimate Party Animal" for nothing. I'll be here if you want a rematch.

jp:
なかなかの遊びっぷりでした
でも　まだまだ遊び足りませんね
us: You're getting there, but you haven't truly embraced your party spirit yet. Let loose and have fun!

jp:
さあ　どちらが究極の名にふさわしいか
決めましょう！
us: Come, let us prove once and for all who is most worthy of the title of "ultimate"!

jp: 遊び人の頂点を　決めるとしましょうか
us: It's about time we settled this, wouldn't you say?

jp: いつでも　お待ちしてますよ
us: I'll be here waiting for you.

jp: 準備ができたら　また声をかけてください
us: Let me know when you're ready to par-tay.

jp: もしかして　怖気づきました？
us: Don't tell me you're chickening out!

jp: 負けました
us: You beat me.

jp:
あなたこそ
『究極の遊び人』を名乗るのにふさわしい
us: And in so doing, proved that you are the Ultimate Party Animal.

jp:
あんたを課長にしておくなんて
神羅は見る目がないな
us:
Couldn't have asked for a better rival.
Guy like you's wasted on Shinra.

jp: ありがとうございます
us: You are too kind.

jp:
それじゃあ　みなさん
新たな遊び人の誕生を　盛大に祝いましょう！
us: Alright everyone─it's time to celebrate the coronation of our new Ultimate Party Animal!

jp: さあ　見てて！
us: Check this out!

jp: おっと　失礼
us: Oh─'scuse me.

jp:
どうしました
えっ……ちょっと落ちついて
us: Hello? Wait─what? Slow down...

jp:
ええ　それで状況は？
なるほど……
us: Uh-huh... And what did they have to say? ...Oh.

jp: わかりました　すぐに戻ります
us: Of course. I'll be there.

jp: どうやら　休暇は終わりのようです
us: It seems my vacation is over.

jp:
会社に戻らないと
部下が泣きながら悲鳴をあげてました
us:
I'm needed at the office.
My assistant was in tears, begging me to return.

jp: 遊び人は　いいのか？
us: What happened to life as a party animal?

jp: もう　いいんです
us: I've had my fill.

jp:
部下たちのまえに立って
上とやりあえるのは　あたしだけですから
us:
And someone has to stand up for my colleagues─
shield them from all the politics and bureaucracy.

jp: 神羅魂か？
us: That the Shinra creed?

jp: いいえ　課長魂です
us: No. It's the middle manager's creed.

jp: それでは　またどこかで
us: Well then, may we meet again.

jp: じゃあ！
us: Soon.

jp:
さあ　さっそく敵味方入り乱れる
大混戦となっております
us: And so today's contest begins. A grand melee where friends and foes face off!

jp:
それにしてもディオ軍団は
なんとも奇妙なメンバーですね
us: If you ask me, though, Dio's fighters seem less like champions and more like chumps!

jp: しかし　あなどってはいけません
us: Ah, but we shouldn't judge them too quickly!

jp:
その中の２名は　我らがコルネオ杯で
優勝をかっさらっていった
カップルなのです！
us: Lest we forget, two of their combatants fled Midgar with our very own Corneo Cup!

jp:
ああ　あれは苦い思い出です
つまり　これはリベンジマーッチ！
us: Don't remind me! The memory of it still stings! And it's all the more reason the family is itchin' to win this grudge match!

jp: そのと～～～り！
us: Right you are!

jp:
我々はチャンピオンベルトを奪還すべく
選りすぐりのチンピ――失礼
us: To reclaim our stolen glory, we've lined up a selection of our finest goons─uh, er...

jp:
『戦士』を
大量投入させていただきました！
us: Finest warriors! A selection of our finest warriors!

jp:
お～っと　コルネオファミリー
絶妙な焼き加減で調理していく！
us: Feel that heat! The Corneo Family's throwin' a barbecue and everyone's invited!

jp:
本日は特別サービス
ちょっぴり強火であぶっております！
us: Check 'em for grill marks, 'cause Dio's Champions are lookin' a little flame-broiled after that one!

jp:
ここからのドンの動きに
注目しましょう！
us: Let's watch and see who he picks!

jp:
火炎放射器の炎に煽られ
会場も　熱気に包まれてまいりました！
us: The only thing more intense than the fires of that flamethrower is the roar of the crowd calling for more!

jp: アプスちゃん　プンスカしてる～！
us: Looks like Abzu's about to go on a rampage!

jp:
暴れ狂うアプスちゃん
ドンもつかまっているのがやっとです！
us: Abzu's had it up to here with this abuse, and the don's hangin' on for dear life!

jp:
はげしく怒り狂うアプスちゃん
完全に　冷静さを失っています！
us: Abzu's totally lost control! It was mean before, but now it's looking positively savage!

jp:
アプスちゃん
ドンを振り落とす勢いで暴れまわる～！
us: Abzu's going absolutely apeshit, and our dear Don Corneo's struggling to ride out the storm!

jp: ドンの意識が飛んでいってしまったー！
us: And with that concussion, the don is out of commission!

jp:
ドン　ド～～～ン！
聞こえてますか？
us: Don! Hey, Don! Don! Are you still with us!?

jp:
ドン　意識が落ちようとも
アプスちゃんからは決して落ちません！
us: The don might've been knocked out, but he hasn't been thrown off! Now that's skill!

jp:
アプスちゃん　ドンが気を失おうと
お構いなしの大暴れです！
us: Hell hath no fury like a pissed-off Abzu without a conscious don to rein it in!

jp:
さあ　ここで一旦リセット
ドン＆アプスちゃんが態勢を整えます
us: I was holdin' my breath for a second there, but it looks like the don and Abzu are back in action!

jp:
アプスちゃん
落ち着きを取り戻したようです
us: Looks like Abzu's got its head screwed back on!

jp:
さあ　ベリーベリーウェルダンに
仕上げていただきましょう！
us: While it's not how I'd take my steak, I'm good with seeing these "champs" served well-done!

jp:
会場を揺るがすほどの
大・激・震～～～！
us: Oh mercy! A positively teeth-rattling, earth-shattering mega quake!

jp: アプスちゃん　熱い想いをぶつけます！
us: Now that's what I call a violent emotional outburst.

jp:
ここで　ドンちゃん印の
スペシャルドリンクの登場だー！
us: Ooh, is that the don's special sauce!? These boys are lookin' to get turnt tonight!

jp:
出た～　ドンちゃんドリーーーンク
ほひ～ほひ～！
us: Oh, it is on now, folks! These dangerous delinquents are doped up on the don's dastardly drink!

jp:
さあ　コルネオファミリー
ドリンク剤のパワーで乗り切れるか！
us: Will the don's signature brew give his fighters the fire and fury to mount a ferocious comeback!?

jp:
さあ　ドンちゃんドリンクを飲み干し
コルネオファミリーが
一発逆転を狙います！
us: Don't look now, but they're sippin' on the don's bad stuff! The Corneo Family's lookin' to turn this fight around!

jp:
さあ　試合はそろそろ
折り返し地点です！
us: It seems like this fight is only growing more and more intense by the minute!

jp:
互いににらみあう両陣営
そろそろ戦況が大きく動くか？
us: I can see the murder in our combatant's eyes. This match is about to get a lot more brutal, folks!

jp:
さあ　後半も
気合いを入れてまいりましょう！
us: This fight isn't over yet! It's still anyone's game!

jp:
ここまではディオ軍団がわずかに有利
ですがこの試合
まだどうなるかわかりません！
us: Dio's Champions might be dog-walking the opposition so far, but don't look away, because these pups've still got bite!

jp: 両者一歩も譲らぬ攻防が続いております
us: A knock-down-drag-out fight! Neither side's giving an inch!

jp:
さすがは神羅の追跡を振りきってきた
逃亡者軍団！
その実力はあなどれません
us: Dio's Champs can hold their own, that's for sure! It's no surprise that these fugitives were able to outrun the long arm of Shinra!

jp:
さあ　このラウンドもいよいよ終盤
リングから目が離せません！
us: We're in the endgame now, folks! And I can't tear my eyes away from these red-hot fisticuffs!

jp:
勢いに乗るディオ軍団　もはや
止める手立てはないのでしょうか！
us: Dio's Champions are dominating! Is there no one who can put a stop to their hot streak!?

jp: さあ　この試合も遂に決着となるか！
us: This match might be approaching its thrilling conclusion!

jp:
ディオ軍団
ここぞとばかりに攻め立てます！
us: Dio's Champions are gettin' ready to bring down the hammer!

jp: ディオ軍団の猛攻が続きます！
us: Dio's Champion's just won't let up!

jp: 最後の瞬間まで勝負はわかりません！
us: But it ain't over until the Fat Chocobo warks, people!

jp:
さあ　目にも止まらぬ速さで
リングを駆けるコルテンダーたち！
us: Faster than the eye can see, these feisty fighters can run rings around the competition!

jp:
エサやりや散歩にも
たいへん苦労いたしました
us: Just tryin' to keep up with 'em on their daily walks was almost impossible!

jp:
コル美　コル夫　コル吉……
愛情を込めてつけた名前も
いまだにどれが誰だかサッパリです！
us: Little Beauty, Pointy Guy, Lucky Spike... I named my babies with love, but I'll be damned if I know which one's which now!

jp:
なるほど　調教に苦労されたんですね
ためになるお話　ありがとうございます
us: You really raised 'em all by yourself? I'm standing in the presence of a bona fide cactuar whisperer!

jp:
そんなコルテンダーたちですが
ディオ軍団を勢いに乗らせない
秘策はありますか？
us: So we know their stories, but do we know if they've got a plan to stop Dio's Champions in their tracks?

jp:
ディオ軍団を針のむしろに！
あっという間に
人間サボテンダーのできあがり～
us: Oh, they've got a plan! It's called, "How many times can you hit a guy with a thousand needles before he's more cactuar than man!?"

jp:
ウォール・マーケット仕込みの
過激なニードル・パフォーマンスを
お楽しみください！
us: Wall Market-born and bred, these succulents are gonna put 'em on pins and needles─literally!

jp:
お～っと　コルテンダー
パワーアップしているのか～？
us: Watch out! Those pointy little pricklers're packin' extra heat now!

jp: まだまだ　ホヒホヒ級ってところだ！
us: You said it! So much heat, it'd make Heidegger blush!

jp:
コルテンダー　攻撃を重ね
遂に最大出力に達したようだ！
us: Oh mama! These mustachioed menaces are fully jacked up and ready to start nailing folks to the walls!

jp:
その一撃はもはや
ホヒホヒのホヒホヒホヒホヒ級～！
us: The spiky little terrors must really want to impress the don, 'cause they're about to go all out!

jp:
本日のスペシャルマッチも
クライマックスを
迎えようとしております！
us: This next special match is shaping up to be a wild and rowdy swan song!

jp:
ドンのためにも　我々は
負けるわけにはいきません！
us: But the family's sworn to stick it out till the end for the down-on-his-luck don!

jp:
ホームだった
ウォール・マーケットを追い出され
us: Chased from his home in Wall Market...

jp:
ネオ・ウォール・マーケット計画も
頓挫したいま
コルネオランドが頼みの綱！
us: and with the Neo Wall Market plans in shambles, Corneoland is his last, greatest hope!

jp:
ドンは　嫁オーディションの禁断症状に
苦しんでいます！
us:
His last chance to escape
his cruel, brideless fate.

jp:
一刻もはやくビューティーガールを集め
ドンのお嫁さんを選ばねばなりません！
us: We need to wrap this contest up quickly, so we can get this man the sexy babes he so rightly deserves!

jp:
そのためには
コルネオランドが必要不可欠！
us: Which is why we need to get Corneoland up and running posthaste!

jp:
ファミリーは決して
ドンの期待を裏切りません！
us: Our family won't let the don down. We will come out on top!

jp:
さあ　我々の野望を背負い
トンベリたちが
ゆっくりと前進していきます！
us: And now we've got tonberries toddling into battle─the weight of our hopes and dreams on their tiny shoulders!

jp:
その包丁で　ファミリーの未来を
切りひらいてくれ！
us: They're gonna slice and dice Dio's guys to bits, and use those bits to build our family's future!

jp:
ここでトンベリの
うらみ節が炸裂だ～！
us: Ooh, I felt that from here! That tonberry had one hell of a bone to pick!

jp: ディオ軍団に天罰が下ったのかー！
us: Now that's what I call divine punishment!

jp: ディオ軍団　フリーーーズ！
us: It's a red light for Dio's Champions!

jp:
積もり積もったトンベリのうらみが
ディオ軍団へと襲いかかります！
us: So much hate and malice and rancor raining down on those poor saps like a ton of bricks!

jp: トンベリの包丁がプスッと決まったー！
us: "Doink" goes the chef knife, and down goes the victim!

jp:
包丁キターーー！
トンベリ　無表情で笑っています
us: That's some deadly kitchenware! The tonberry ain't showin' it, but you know he's lovin' this!

jp:
イタタタタタタ　イタすぎる！
磨きあげた包丁が突き立てられます

イリーナ選手
狙った獲物は逃しません！
us: Elena the huntress spots her prey and strikes true!

jp:
ふ～む　イリーナ君のほうが
上手だったようだね
us: Hmm, it seems she managed to connect this time.

jp: ルード選手　たまらず崩れ落ちた～！
us: Rude's been brought to his knees! Can he get back on his feet!?

jp:
あ～っと　ルード選手ダウーーーン！
タークスペア　苦戦しております
us: Say it ain't so, folks: Rude just went down hard! Can the Turks mount a comeback? Let's find out!

jp: あのルード君を崩すとは　やるね
us: To have Rude on the ropes is no small feat!

jp: イリーナ選手　まさかのピーンチ！
us: Uh-oh! Elena's in a bit of a bind here!

jp: たまらず膝を折るイリーナ選手！
us: The feisty Elena has been brought to her knees!

jp: イリーナ君　頑張ってもらいたいね
us: Now let's see what Elena is made of!

jp:
おっと　なにやら
不穏な動きを見せるタークスペア！
us: Uh-oh, what's this? Our two Turks look like they're getting into position.

jp: これは……くるね
us: Oh, this ought to be good.

jp:
会場を包む　ただならぬ緊張感
ここで戦況が大きく動くか？
us: The tension's so thick you could cut it with a knife! The Turks are planning something big, but will it be big enough to turn the tide of this battle!?

jp:
リング中央で構えるタークスペア
ここで勝負を決める気でしょうか？
us: The Turks take center stage and prepare to make their next move─but will it lead them to victory!?

jp:
さあ　タークスペアが
連携の構えに入りました！
us: Check it out: the Turks are readying a real showstopper. Let's see what they've got in store!

jp: 注目　タークスが本気になったようだね
us: The Turks have a trick up their sleeves, but what could it be!?

jp:
すさまじい～～～！
タークスの制裁が戦意ごと奪い去ります
us: Oh mercy! That's gonna leave a mark! If I were their opponents, I'd be scrambling to throw in the towel!

jp:
絶対的な力の差を見せつける
タークスペア！
これこそが神羅カンパニーの底力です
us: With a dazzling display of power, Elena and Rude overwhelm their opponents! They've proven that there's no stopping Shinra's finest─no sir!

jp:
ブラボー　タークス！
ふう　敵にまわしたくないものだね
us: Kudos to the Turks for pulling off that attack. And thank heavens I wasn't on the receiving end of it!

jp:
お～っと　ここで電話だ～！
こっち　そっち　どっち？
us: Dio's phone is ringing off the hook! But who's on the other end!?

jp:
うん？　もしもし――
ああ　社長……
us: Hm? Hello? Yes, this is he. Oh, Mr. President! To what do I owe the pleasure?

jp:
すまない　急用が入ったようだ
私はいったん中座させてもらうよ
us: Sorry, you'll have to excuse me. I have some...business to attend to.

jp:
おっと　ディオ園長
なにかのトラブルでしょうか？
us: Uh-oh! Must be pretty urgent to pull the director away.

jp:
さあ　遂に佳境を迎える
ディオ軍団 vs タークスペアの１戦！
us: Especially since our heated match between Dio's Champions and the Turks is about to reach a fever pitch!

jp:
実況は引き続き
ソッチ＆コッチで盛りあげてまいります
us: Dio may be bowing out, but Kotch and I will continue to cover this thrilling fight!

jp:
ルード選手　遂にダウーーーン！
鉄壁要塞がいま崩れ落ちました
us: And just like that, Rude has been taken out of the fight! The indomitable badass has fallen! Is this the end for the Turks!?

jp: さあ　後を託されたイリーナ選手
us: It all rests upon young Elena's shoulders now!

jp:
期待のルーキーは　このピンチを
乗り越えることができるのでしょうか！
us: Is this new recruit capable of avenging her partner all by her lonesome? Let's see!

jp:
イリーナ選手
ここで　あえなくダウーーーン！
us: Ya hate to see it, folks! Elena is out of commission!

jp:
残るは　ルード選手のみ
窮地を乗り越え
輝ける勝利をつかむことができるのか！
us: Only Rude remains! Victory and glory are still within his grasp─so long as he can overcome these odds!

jp:
ルーファウス　ルーファウス神羅～
新しい～社長～♪
us:
We salute you, Rufus Shinra
Our president who we all adore♪

jp:
いやはや　園長
これはトンでもない事態になりました！
us: Gotta say, Director, I wasn't expecting such an impressive special guest!

jp:
フフフ　私も新社長から
参戦の打診を受けた時はビックリしたよ
us: Nor was I. The president's proposal caught me entirely by surprise.

jp:
さっそくですが　園長は
ルーファウス社長をどう分析されますか
us: Now that our VIP has entered the fray, how do you envision this fight playing out?

jp:
神羅のトップだ
ただものではないことは確かだが
正直　バトラーしては未知数だね
us: Well, it takes tenacity to climb the corporate ladder, but whether that will translate to the arena is anyone's guess.

jp: それは　ある意味恐ろしいですね
us: You're saying this could be a big gamble for the president?

jp:
彼が勝算のない場に出てくるはずがない
それだけ　自信があるんだろう
us: Yes, though I doubt he's leaving it all to chance. He would never commit to a losing venture.

jp:
確実なのは　この１戦が
今後語り継がれていくであろう
伝説の試合になるということだけだ
us: All I can say with confidence is that this bout will be discussed for weeks and months to come! Perhaps even years!

jp: なるほど　なるほどなるほど！
us: You hear that, folks? This is history in the making!

jp: ルーファウス選手の手厳しい一撃！
us: Oof! That's the kind of hit you'll be feeling for a week!

jp:
決まった～！
社長自ら手を下すのが神羅流です
us: That's Shinra's president for you, folks! A terror in the boardroom and on the battlefield!

jp:
ルーファウス選手の
懲戒処分が炸裂します！
us: Looks like the new prez knows how to dish out the punishment!

jp:
ルーファウス選手
着実にクラウド選手を追い詰めていく！
us: Rufus is turning up the heat! Does Cloud even stand a chance against this onslaught!?

jp:
すさまじい熱血指導！
クラウド選手の処分やいかに
us: The president of Shinra isn't afraid to get his hands dirty! Now that's how ya get to the top!

jp:
神羅カンパニーの公開懲戒ショー！
社長自ら部下を厳しく指導していきます
us: Take a good, long look, folks! This is what happens when you dare to defy Shinra! The big boss himself steps in to bring his rogue subordinates back in line!

jp:
あの身のこなし
幼い頃からの訓練の賜物だろう
お父上の愛情がうかがえるよ
us: Such skill! No doubt the result of training since childhood. I daresay he has his father to thank for that.

jp:
いまの一撃……
社長にしておくのが惜しいくらいだね
us: Truly, the president's martial talents are wasted in the boardroom!

jp:
ルーファウス選手
まともに食らってしまった～！
us: I dunno about you, folks, but I felt that one from over here!

jp:
クラウド選手
『社長だろうが関係ないね』と
言わんばかりに攻め立てます！
us: Cloud is all, "You're the president of jack shit"─showing his opponent utter disrespect!

jp:
クラウド選手　相手が上司だろうと
まったく容赦がありません！
us: There's no love lost between Cloud and his former employer, folks! He is goin' at it!

jp:
ルーファウス選手　食らったー！
ここは間合いを見誤ったか
us: And Rufus is forced to eat shit! That was a grave misjudgment on the executive's part, folks!

jp:
ルーファウス君　やられたね
ズシリと効いていそうだ
us: Right where it hurts... I doubt the president enjoyed that.

jp: ルーファウス君　ここは耐えてほしいね
us: Things are looking a bit grim for the president.

jp:
ルーファウス選手　ピーーーンチ！
神羅関係者のどよめきが
聞こえてくるようです！
us: Cloud's got Rufus on the ropes! What's that I hear? Sounds like Shinra collectively shitting its pants!

jp:
激しさを増すクラウド選手の猛攻！
ルーファウス選手
はたして立ち直せるか
us: Cloud's clearly not pulling any punches! Can Rufus claw his way back after such a devastating drubbing!?

jp:
おおう　さすがのルーファウス君も
内心穏やかではないだろうね
us: Oh dear, the president looks out on his feet! He needs to gather his wits─and fast!

jp:
ダークネイションの参戦に　観客席も
更なる盛りあがりを見せております！
us: Who let the dog out!? The crowd is going absolutely wild as Darkstar makes his arena debut!

jp:
頼もしい相棒を得て
ルーファウス君に勢いが戻ったようだね
us: With his faithful friend at his side, I'd say the president might still have a fighting chance.

jp:
タイマン勝負から一転
クラウド選手は
厳しい戦いを強いられそうです！
us: The odds are certainly in his favor! Can Cloud win this two-on-one clash, or will he crumble!?

jp:
いや　どうかな？
彼は元ソルジャー　これでようやく
五分といったところかもしれないよ
us: This is a former SOLDIER we're talking about. One could argue that Darkstar has merely leveled the playing field.

jp:
飼い慣らした相棒との
見事なコンビネーションが炸裂します！
us: You'd be hard-pressed to find a stronger bond between man and dog than this!

jp:
ルーファウス＆ダークネイション
神羅カンパニーの未来は安泰だ～！
us: I tell ya, Shinra's got a rosy future ahead of it with Rufus and his faithful pooch at the helm!

jp:
固い絆で結ばれた主人と相棒
どれだけ　しつければ
この忠誠心が生まれるのか！
us: No way could Rufus call off this dog! Darkstar's love and devotion is undeniable! I'd be touched, if not for the carnage!

jp:
相棒の助けを得て
ルーファウス選手の猛攻が決まります！
us: Rufus and Darkstar are pouring it on! What a devastating duo!

jp:
ふふ　『とっても仲良しで賞』を
贈らせてもらうよ
us: Were it up to me, Darkstar would be named Best in Show!

jp:
すばらしい！
私は　イヌよりもネコ派なんだが
考えをあらためるとするよ
us: Amazing! I've always been a cat person, but Darkstar is making me question my allegiances!

jp: ダークネイション　シットダウーン！
us: Darkstar demonstrating the classic "down" trick!

jp: ダークネイション　這いつくばった～！
us: Darkstar is reeling from that punishment!

jp:
主人以外にひざまずかされる屈辱！
ルーファウス選手も　動揺が隠せません
us: Ooh, the utter humiliation of having to sit for someone other than his master! Even Rufus is visibly shaken, folks!

jp:
さあ　クラウド選手
標的をダークネイションに絞るのか？
us: Cloud's setting his sights on Darkstar to even the odds! But will this strategy succeed!?

jp:
伏せてしまったか……
ルーファウス君たちの強固な連携も
ここまでかな
us: Darkstar's in the doghouse! But is Cloud about to send the pooch back to the pound?

jp:
う～む　ダークネイション
もういちど　尻尾を立ててほしいね
us: Aww, poor Darkstar... Let's hope he's only playing dead!

jp:
奮闘虚しく力尽きる
ダークネイショーーーン！
us: The crowd is howling as the loyal hound Darkstar goes down for the count!

jp:
主人を守り切れず
さぞ　無念なことだろう
us: He'll be leaving with his tail between his legs after this showing.

jp:
頼もしい相棒を失ったルーファウス選手
この怒りをぶつけるべき相手は
いま　まさに　目のまえにいます！
us: Rufus must be raging at the loss of his partner─and I have no doubt he'll be takin' all that anger out on Cloud and sending him to the doghouse!

jp:
にらみあう神羅のトップと元ソルジャー
だれがこの激戦を予想したでしょうか！
us: Shinra's commander in chief versus an ex-SOLDIER: First Class! No one could have predicted a matchup like this in a million years!

jp:
さあ　最後にリングに立ち
勝利の栄冠をつかむのは
そっち　こっち　どっちだ！
us: This is truly a fight for the ages! Only one will leave this arena a winner, but who will it be!?

jp: いてまうでー
やったるですー
おんどレ　こラ～
おっぽふリふリや～
こレで　どないや～
いただきまするー
ガブガブすんでぇ
いたいでするー
うラ～　いたいやんけえ　わレ～
ごめんってば　もうやめてぇ
エンカウントエラーです

このメッセージをみたひとは
ほうこくしてください
テスト０でーす　よろしゅう！

テスト０です
よろしくおねがいします！
馬鹿な　わらわが負けただと？
us: Impossible! What foul sorcery...!?

jp:
おのれ　魔女め……
また　わらわを阻むか！
us:
Accursed witch!
Even in death, you would thwart me!

jp: クラウド……
us: Cloud?

jp: 平気か？
us: You good?

jp: 女王は……？
us: What about...?

jp: もう　大丈夫だ
us: She's gone.

jp: はたしてそうかな？
us: Oh, she is, is she?

jp: さあ　傀儡らしく　わらわのものになれ
us: Be still, little puppet. You belong to me now!

jp: クラウド！
us: Cloud!

jp: 女王のカードを！
us: Use the card!

jp: させるか！
us: Don't you dare!

jp: 遊びは終わりだ
us: Game over!

jp: ありがとう　クラウド
us: Thank you, Cloud.

jp: 女王を……わたしを止めてくれて
us: For stopping her... For stopping me.

jp:
天才なんて持ち上げられて
いい気になってたんだよね
us:
Guess I really let all that "genius" crap
go to my head, huh?

jp:
そのくせ　裏では負けることに怯えて
がむしゃらに力を求めた
us:
After a while, losing became my worst nightmare.
I'd do anything to win.

jp: その結果が　これ
us: And look where it got me.

jp: 掘り起こした伝承が悪かったな
us: You are not to blame for this.

jp:
あれは　心の隙間に入り込み
広まることで力を持つ　そういう存在だ
us:
Evil like that preys on our deepest, darkest fears,
and worms its way into our hearts.

jp: 抗うことは難しい
us: Few ever break free.

jp:
ただの天才なんて存在しない
ぜんぶ　努力の結果だろ
us: You're the best because you worked your ass off. Not because you're a "genius."

jp: 胸を張れ
us: Got it?

jp: うん……
us: Got it.

jp: いちから　頑張らなきゃ
us: Well, on that note...

jp:
もし　また女王が蘇ろうとしたら
今度はわたしが倒せるように
us: I'd better get back to it. After all, there can only be one card queen.

jp: 次は負けないから　また勝負しようね
us:
So next time you wanna throw down,
you best come prepared.

jp: では　私も戻ることにしよう
us: All's well that ends well, I suppose.

jp: 助かった
us: Thanks to you.

jp: こんなところで死なれては困るからな
us: Couldn't have you dying on me just yet.

jp: 大丈夫　大丈夫
us: Relax, I'll be fine.

jp:
そんなワケないでしょ
ひとりじゃ　危険だって
us: Not on your own, you won't. It's way too dangerous out there!

jp: 俺たちも行くよ
us: We're going with you.

jp: はあ　さっさと終わらせたいの
us: ...It's just faster to do it myself.

jp: クエ～……
us: Kweh...

jp: いらっしゃい
us: Hey there.

jp: おでかけ？
us: Heading out?

jp: 見まわり　ちょっと気になる報告があってね
us: On patrol. Got a slightly troubling report.

jp: 団長ったら　ひとりで行くって言うから
us: But not "troubling" enough to let us go with her.

jp: だって　それがいちばん合理的よ
us: I'm captain. It just makes sense for me to go.

jp: 俺たちから見ると　そうじゃない
us: Yeah, but not by yourself.

jp: またそこに戻る？
us: We're talking in circles.

jp: はいは～い！
us: If I may!

jp:
ご存知のとおり　うちのクラウド
そういうの　すっごく得意なの
us: As you can tell by looking at him, Cloud here has a lot of experience taking care of "trouble."

jp: 見まわり　クラウドにまかせてみる？
us: So why don't you send him on patrol instead?

jp:
俺が代わりに行く
気が済むまで　話し合え
us: Don't worry─I'll go. Give you time to talk things over.

jp: 頼んじゃう？
us: Whaddya think?

jp: そうだね　今回は甘えちゃおうか
us: Okay, then. If you've got time to spare.

jp:
最近　村の近くで
危険なモンスターの目撃情報があってね
us: Recently, folks have spotted some foul-looking fiends outside the village.

jp:
高台にある物見塔にのぼって
なにか異常がないか　様子を見てきてほしいの
us: I want you to head to the observation tower. Take a look around─see if you notice anything suspicious.

jp: うん　まかせて
us: Just leave it to him.

jp:
高台に　古い物見塔があるの
そこからなら　あたり一帯を見渡せるはずよ
us: The tower's up on the outlook. It should serve as a good vantage point for surveying the surrounding area.

jp: 頼ってばかりで　悪いね
us: Sorry for getting you wrapped up in all this.

jp:
見まわりのシフト問題は　定期的に発生するんだ
団長がひとりで行きたがるせいさ
us: Wasn't the first argument we've had about patrol duty. The captain can be pretty stubborn sometimes.

jp: わあ～！
us: It's beautiful!

jp: モンスターを探そう
us: No time for sightseeing.

jp: あそこが怪しい　行ってみよう
us: Activity over there. Let's go.

jp: モンスターの影が見えた　調べてみよう
us: Think I spotted something. Let's check it out.

jp:
このあたりでよく見かけるモンスターだ
シスネが警戒しているのとは　別物だろう
us: Hmm. You can find fiends like these anywhere. Cissnei must've been referring to something else.

jp: 高台に戻るぞ
us: Back to the outlook.

jp:
いまのも違うか……
もういちど　高台へ戻ってみよう
us: Nope, not the fiend we want. Should probably take another peek from the outlook.

jp:
クラウド　あそこ！
いま　なんか動いた
us: Cloud, look over there! I just saw something moving!

jp: あいつだな　見失うまえに向かうぞ
us: Bingo. Let's not lose sight of it.

jp: うわっ　巨大！
us: Whoa, that's ginormous!

jp: いい動きしてるわね
us: That's some fine work.

jp: えっ　いつの間に
us: Huh? When did you get here?

jp:
コソコソついて来ちゃった
クラウドは　気づいてたかもね
us: Been following you for a while. But I'm sure Cloud already knew that.

jp: まあ……な
us: Yeah, well...

jp: なかなか　いい眺めだったでしょ？
us: View from the outlook was pretty nice, huh?

jp:
あそこからなら　村にやってくる人も
いちはやく見つけることができるの
us: I like to relax there. Plus, it's easy to spot people coming our way well in advance.

jp: もしかして　だれか待ってる？
us: Wait, are you expecting someone?

jp: あんたには　いろいろ聞きたいと思っていたんだ
us: I've got a lotta questions I've been meaning to ask you, y'know.

jp:
そう？　じゃあ
話せることなら答えるわ
us: That so? Fine, but I don't have all day.

jp: ただし　質問はひとつだけよ
us: You get one question, and one question only.

jp: 私の待ち人は……もう死んでしまったの
us: As silly as it sounds...someone who isn't with us anymore.

jp: でも　全然そんな気がしなくて
us: But he doesn't feel gone.

jp:
そういうヤツなの
ある日　ひょこっと帰ってきそうで
us: It's like I wouldn't be surprised if I woke up one day and saw him outside our gates.

jp:
恋愛めいた感情があるわけじゃないわ
でも　気になって仕方がない
us: He's not an ex or anything like that. Dunno what he was, but...I really miss the guy.

jp: うん……
us: I get it.

jp: 顔を見て　安心したいんだよね
us: Wish I could see him again. Make sure he's alright.

jp:
そう　これは彼のためじゃなくて
私のため
us: Though if I'm bein' honest─it's just for my sake, isn't it? Not his.

jp: なにがあったんだ
us: Something happen between you?

jp:
彼の人生の一部を奪ってしまった
その責任の一端は　私にもある
us: This is gonna sound cryptic and weird, I know, but...I stole part of his life from him─and I gotta carry that.

jp: あっ！
us: Hold on!

jp: 質問はひとつだけって言ったじゃない
us: Didn't I say one question?

jp: 私の正体は――
us: Well, the truth is...

jp:
ああ　これはパス
言いたくない
us: The truth is, that's none of your business.

jp: 元神羅の一員　それは確実だ
us: You're ex-Shinra. That much I know for a fact.

jp:
いや　タークスの施設で会ったよな
元じゃなくて　現役か
us: Then again, we ran into you at a Turks' facility, so you might still be working for some asshole in a suit.

jp:
でも　神羅の社員なんて大勢いる
元社員だって珍しくもない
us: But it's a big company. Nothing weird about crossing paths with someone who's got ties to it, current or former.

jp: それを隠すのは　なにか特別な職種──
us: Which means there's no reason to hide them. Unless you were part of some─

jp:
あなたの想像は当たらずとも遠からず
でも　村の人たちには知られたくないの
us: You're more than welcome to think whatever theories you like. I'd appreciate it, though, if you didn't share them with the villagers.

jp:
都会から来た　やけに強いお姉さん
